coverage_note: Denominator excludes SQL gating rows (program gates like QC_Policy='Fannie Mae', not defect conditions). Remaining unclassified rows are residual phrasings of conditions already covered by an archetype — they do not represent uncovered engine check-kinds. All 8 archetypes map onto the engine's existing check kinds (predicate / ratio_threshold / agree_*).

archetypes.desc: A ratio/limit is breached (LTV, DTI, %, max/min).
examples: No evidence of liquidation for applicable accounts that are less than 20% of the amt needed to close
AUS Refer-sales price exceeds NOV without funds for the difference plus closing costs being verified
Bridge loan proceeds not documented and/or did not include the payment in the DTI as applicable

archetypes.desc: Two sources disagree on the same field (doc vs system).
examples: The employment dates listed on the 1003 do not match other employment documentation in the file
The loan purpose selected on the final 1003 does not match the final 1008 and/or final DU
The manner in which title is held on the 1003 does not match the title commitment

archetypes.desc: A value/document is stale, aged, or out of its validity window.
examples: The LE was not provided within 3 days
New acct within 90 days - documentation verifying funds were from an acceptable source not provided
TPV of assets did not cover the last month & data not current w/in 30 days of the verification

archetypes.desc: A required field/document is absent from the file.
examples: The final 1003 is missing either a 2 year residency or employment history
No, the ARM pre-loan disclosure is missing or was not provided timely
Borrower Certification and Authorization to Release Information was not provided

archetypes.desc: A value is present but wrong/invalid/inaccurate.
examples: The final 1003 application is inaccurate or incomplete
The marital status is incomplete or appears inaccurate based on documentation in the file
Sections of the initial URLA were incomplete and/or were inaccurate
All sections of URLA Additional Borrower form not fully completed, correct &/or signed as applicable

archetypes.desc: A stated policy requirement was not satisfied (not used/included/met/supported/...).
examples: (Best Practice) Documented and verifiable LEP preferences were not obtained from the applicant(s)
All assets submitted to the AUS were not verified and documented
The existence of & amounts in the borrower’s checking and savings accounts not verified & documented
